g.text: Seven pool cores share one queue:
steal the head, then take the account's token
03 §4.2a · the pool: tokens, stealing and segment masks (01 §14.15)
CCD7 L3 (32 MiB): token table · per-core RX rings · consumer locks · pooled Segment16 blocks
own queue empty: CAS the sibling's consumer lock, take its head packet
put back, take the next queue head
+20 ns on every pooled path, and
no cache line leaves CCD7 for it
